name: reflexbrain-lab-environment
description: Metabolizujace srodowisko badawcze, Atlas Stolu Okazow i lekki mikroskop przyczynowy dla ReflexBrain Lab (zero zewnetrznych zaleznosci, Node >= 20).

scripts.straznik:head: node tools/straznik.mjs --tree HEAD
scripts.render: node tools/sprawdz-lab.mjs --render-wiedza && node tools/render-atlas.mjs && node tools/drogi.mjs --raport DROGI.md && node proby/00-kalibrator-mikroskopu/build-html.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/tools.test.mjs && node tests/kernel.test.mjs && node tests/kalibrator-smoke.test.mjs
scripts.check:all: node tools/sprawdz-lab.mjs --check && node tools/render-atlas.mjs --check && node tools/drogi.mjs --check-raport DROGI.md && node proby/00-kalibrator-mikroskopu/build-html.mjs --check && node tools/straznik.mjs --working && node tests/tools.test.mjs && node tests/kernel.test.mjs && node tests/kalibrator-smoke.test.mjs
